Name: Pet Whispers
Author: YourPeachiness
Description:
Pet Whispers - Your Pets Talk Back

Pet your cat, dog, or turtle and they say something back in a speech bubble
above their head.

FEATURES

* 147 lines, all in English and Chinese
* Three separate voice sets: Cat, Dog, Turtle (turtles are not dogs with a
  different skin - they have their own slow, old, quiet way of talking)
* Five friendship tiers, aligned with the game's own hearts
  (200 points = 1 heart, max 1000)
    - 0-199    not attached yet: only body language and silence
    - 200-399  first heart
    - 400-599  second heart
    - 600-799  third heart
    - 800-1000 fourth and fifth heart - the deepest lines live here
* Conditional lines for rain, winter, late night, and low stamina.
  These are weighted against the tier lines (60/40 by default) instead of
  overriding them, so you still hear both.
* Four one-time milestone lines per pet:
    - the very first time you pet them
    - the day friendship reaches 1000
    - the 100th petting
    - the 500th petting
* No repeats: the last 8 lines spoken are temporarily excluded.
* The heart: the base game deliberately does NOT draw emotes on pets
  (NPC.DrawEmote has an explicit "!(this is Pet)" check), so this mod draws
  it for them - using the game's own emote sheet and geometry.
* A sound on every petting: vanilla only plays the pet's own sound the first
  time each day; this mod plays it every time.
* A morning reminder to fill the pet bowls on non-rainy days.
  (Rain fills them automatically, so it stays quiet then - and it only
  reminds you if a bowl is actually empty.)

CONFIG

Everything is configurable in config.json, or nothing at all if you are happy
with the defaults:

  OnlyFirstPetPerDay      false  talk every time, or only on the first pet of the day
  HeartEveryPet          true    show a heart on repeat pettings too
  SoundEveryPet          true    play the pet's sound on repeat pettings too
  PetSound                ""      override the sound cue (blank = the pet's own)
  WaterReminder          true    morning bowl reminder
  ChancePercent          100    chance to speak at all
  BubbleDuration          7000    how long the bubble stays (ms)
  BubbleDelayMs          400    delay before it appears (ms)
  ShowHeart              true    draw the heart
  DogsSpeak              true    toggle dogs
  ConditionChancePercent  60      weight of conditional lines vs tier lines
  DontInterruptBubble    true    a new petting will not overwrite a line you
                                  are still reading

CONSOLE COMMANDS

  pet_say        make every pet speak (testing)
  pet_friend N  set a pet's friendship, 0-1000 (testing)
  pet_water      check the bowls and fire the reminder (testing)

REQUIREMENTS

* SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
* Stardew Valley 1.6

TRANSLATIONS

English and Chinese are included. Adding a language means copying
i18n/default.json and translating the values - no code changes needed.

NOTES

* The heart is added by this mod. In the unmodified game pets never show an
  emote, even though the game does set the emote state internally - it simply
  skips drawing it for pets. This mod only draws what vanilla already asked
  for.
* The pet's own sound comes from Data/Pets. If a breed has no sound assigned,
  set PetSound to any vanilla cue to substitute.
